PLEASE Share pics of your marines with this helmet and torso. I would love to see them!!!





This power armor can famously be seen in "Death of Hope" ( https://youtu.be/x9wV2sGlXjY?si=e7_qug-AP1O7-cLG ) by SparksArtifex on Youtube, though the design it is based on is clearly much older, dating back to rogue trader art (see in images)


Credit to SparxArtifex for the modern redesign these files are based on.





Includes:





Helmet:


- Version with sculpted hoses, can be put on any torso


- Version with pre-drilled holes in the respirator for you to attach 1mm stretchy hobby cord to, normally used for making jewelry (see Image).





"Spaced Armor Hemisphere" Pauldron:


- Two Versions with and two versions without power cabling, either with or without additional neck protection trim





Model shown in picture uses the Torso designed by Hellforged Miniatures for this Mark of Armor:


https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/mkiv-power-armor-delta-oberon-pattern-torso





Credit to Mucker71 for sculpting the Helm and the extra armor on the Pauldron. (https://cults3d.com/de/benutzer/Magos_Datasmith_Diodelosus/3d-modelle) for modeling it





Base pauldron remixed from "Gen 4 Holy Crusader Marines" by Satur9 (https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/game/gen-4-holy-crusader-marines ), thanks for the design!





all models modified by me later for better fit/ more versions





The old rogue trader artwork shown here is from: https://warhammer40000roguetrader.blogspot.com/2012/06/art-of-rogue-trader.html





Credit to the Warhammer 40k Homebrew Wiki for coming up with the custom name and Lore (https://wh40khomebrew.fandom.com/wiki/Power_Armour,_Variants_and_Sub-Patterns#Mark_IV%CE%94_(Delta)_%22Oberon%22_Pattern)
